fields.name: Advantage and Disadvantage
fields.desc: Roll twice and use the better (advantage) or worse (disadvantage) result. Multiple sources of advantage or disadvantage do not stack — you either have it or you don't. Advantage and disadvantage cancel each other out.

fields.name: Difficulty Class
fields.desc: Easy DC 9, Normal DC 12, Hard DC 15, Extreme DC 18. Characters roll d20 + relevant stat modifier against the DC.

fields.name: Focus Spells
fields.desc: Focus spells last as long as you concentrate. You can't cast other focus spells while focusing. Taking damage requires a DC 12 CON check or you lose focus.

fields.name: Torch and Light
fields.desc: Torches last 1 hour of real time. Characters without darkvision must carry a light source or be blind. Tracking real time is core to Shadowdark play.

fields.name: Spell Casting Check
fields.desc: To cast a spell, roll d20 + relevant stat modifier vs DC 10 + spell tier. On a failure the spell doesn't fire but the slot is consumed. Critical failure triggers a mishap (Wizard only).

fields.name: Backstab
fields.desc: Thieves deal an extra weapon die of damage when hitting a creature unaware of the attack, plus additional weapon dice equal to half thief level (rounded down).

fields.name: Morale
fields.desc: Monsters check morale (DC 15 WIS) when half their number are defeated or when a powerful ally falls. Failure means they flee or surrender.

fields.name: Dying and Death
fields.desc: At 0 HP a character is dying. Each round make a DC 15 CON check or die. A natural 20 stabilises at 1 HP. Allies can stabilise you with a DC 12 WIS check.

fields.name: Encumbrance and Gear Slots
fields.desc: Characters have gear slots equal to their Strength score (minimum 10). Each item occupies 1 slot unless noted. Exceeding slots imposes disadvantage on physical checks.

fields.name: Weapon Mastery
fields.desc: Fighters choose one weapon type and gain +1 to attack and damage, plus half their level (rounded down) added to those rolls.

fields.name: Turn Undead
fields.desc: Priests cast turn undead as a spell (it doesn't count toward known spells). Undead of LV equal to or less than the roll result flee for 2d4 rounds.

fields.name: Random Encounters
fields.desc: Every 10 minutes in the Shadowdark, roll d6. On a 1, a random encounter occurs. This makes resource management and light tracking critical.
